en.statement:
Suggest suitable match between function given in the first column and its description given in the second column.

$$\begin{array}{|l|l|l|l|} \hline & \textbf{Column-I} & & \textbf{Column-II} \\ \hline (\text{A}) & \sin(390^\circ) & (\text{P}) & \text{Positive} \\ \hline (\text{B}) & \sin(-30^\circ) & (\text{Q}) & \text{Negative} \\ \hline (\text{C}) & \cos 120^\circ & (\text{R}) & \text{Zero} \\ \hline (\text{D}) & \tan(-120^\circ) & (\text{S}) & \text{Modulus is greater than one} \\ \hline \end{array}$$
en.solution:
Concept : Trigonometric values in different quadrants.

Solution :
(A) $\sin(390^\circ) = \sin(360^\circ + 30^\circ) = \sin 30^\circ = 1/2 > 0$ (Positive $\rightarrow$ P)
(B) $\sin(-30^\circ) = -\sin 30^\circ = -1/2 < 0$ (Negative $\rightarrow$ Q)
(C) $\cos 120^\circ = \cos(180^\circ - 60^\circ) = -\cos 60^\circ = -1/2 < 0$ (Negative $\rightarrow$ Q)
(D) $\tan(-120^\circ) = -\tan(120^\circ) = \tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3} \approx 1.732$ (Positive $\rightarrow$ P, and modulus $> 1 \rightarrow$ S)

Final Answer : Option (B)

en.statement:
Match List-I with List-II :

$$\begin{array}{llll} & \textbf{List-I} & & \textbf{List-II} \\ (a) & h\text{ (Planck's constant)} & (i) & [\text{M L T}^{-1}] \\ (b) & E\text{ (kinetic energy)} & (ii) & [\text{M L}^2\text{ T}^{-1}] \\ (c) & V\text{ (electric potential)} & (iii) & [\text{M L}^2\text{ T}^{-2}] \\ (d) & P\text{ (linear momentum)} & (iv) & [\text{M L}^2\text{ I}^{-1}\text{T}^{-3}] \end{array}$$

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
en.solution:
Concept : Determine dimensional formulas using fundamental physical relations: $h = E/\nu$, $E = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$, $V = W/q$, and $P = mv$.

Solution :
(a) Planck's constant: $[h] = [\text{M L}^2\text{T}^{-2}]/[\text{T}^{-1}] = [\text{M L}^2\text{T}^{-1}] \rightarrow$ (ii)

(b) Kinetic energy: $[E] = [\text{M}][\text{L T}^{-1}]^2 = [\text{M L}^2\text{T}^{-2}] \rightarrow$ (iii)

(c) Electric potential: $[V] = [\text{M L}^2\text{T}^{-2}]/[\text{I T}] = [\text{M L}^2\text{I}^{-1}\text{T}^{-3}] \rightarrow$ (iv)

(d) Linear momentum: $[P] = [\text{M}][\text{L T}^{-1}] = [\text{M L T}^{-1}] \rightarrow$ (i)

Final Answer : Option (B)

en.statement: A balloon is made of a material of surface tension $S$ and has a small inflation outlet (from where gas is filled inside it) of small area $A$. It is filled with a gas of density $ho$ and it takes a spherical shape of radius $R$. When the gas is allowed to flow out freely from it, its radius $r$ becomes zero from $R$ in time $T$. If the speed of the gas coming out of the balloon $v(r)$ depends on $r$ as $r^a$ and $T \propto S^\alpha A^\beta \rho^\gamma R^\delta$, then
en.solution:
Concept : Excess pressure inside a balloon is $P = 2S/r$ and efflux velocity is $v = \sqrt{2P/\rho}$.

Solution : From $v = \sqrt{4S/(\rho r)} \propto r^{-1/2}$, we get $a = -1/2$. Using rate of flow, $-dV/dt = A v \implies -4\pi r^2 dr/dt = A \sqrt{4S/(\rho r)}$. Integrating from $r = R$ to $0$ gives $T = \frac{4\pi}{7A} \sqrt{\frac{\rho}{S}} R^{7/2} \propto S^{-1/2} A^{-1} \rho^{1/2} R^{7/2}$. Comparing powers, we get $\alpha = -1/2, \beta = -1, \gamma = 1/2, \delta = 7/2$.

Final Answer : Option (C)

hi.statement: एक गुब्बारा पृष्ठ तनाव $S$ के पदार्थ से बना हुआ है और इसके इन्फ्लेशन आउटलेट (जहाँ से इसके अन्दर गैस भरी जाती है) का छोटा क्षेत्रफल $A$ है। इसे घनत्व $\rho$ की एक गैस से भरा जाता है और यह त्रिज्या $R$ की एक गोलाकार आकृति ले लेता है जब गैस को स्वतंत्र रूप से इससे बाहर प्रवाहित होने दिया जाता है तो इसकी त्रिज्या $r$, समय $T$ में $R$ से शून्य हो जाती है यदि गुब्बारे से बाहर आने वाली गैस की चाल $v(r)$, $r$ पर $r^a$ के रूप में निर्भर करती है और $T \propto S^\alpha A^\beta \rho^\gamma R^\delta$ है, तो
hi.solution:
सिद्धांत : गुब्बारे के अंदर अतिरिक्त दाब $P = 2S/r$ और बहिःस्राव वेग $v = \sqrt{2P/\rho}$ होता है।

हल : $v = \sqrt{4S/(\rho r)} \propto r^{-1/2}$ से, हमें $a = -1/2$ प्राप्त होता है। प्रवाह की दर से, $-dV/dt = A v \implies -4\pi r^2 dr/dt = A \sqrt{4S/(\rho r)}$। $r = R$ से $0$ तक समाकलन करने पर $T = \frac{4\pi}{7A} \sqrt{\frac{\rho}{S}} R^{7/2} \propto S^{-1/2} A^{-1} \rho^{1/2} R^{7/2}$ प्राप्त होता है।

अंतिम उत्तर : विकल्प (C)

en.statement: If $\vec{A} \times \vec{B} = \vec{C}$, then which of the following statements is wrong?
en.solution:
Concept : The vector product $\vec{C} = \vec{A} \times \vec{B}$ is perpendicular to the plane containing $\vec{A}$ and $\vec{B}$, and parallel to itself.

Solution : Since $\vec{C} = \vec{A} \times \vec{B}$, the vector $\vec{C}$ is parallel to $(\vec{A} \times \vec{B})$, not perpendicular. Hence, $\vec{C} \perp (\vec{A} \times \vec{B})$ is incorrect.

Final Answer : Option (D)

hi.solution:

en.statement: Which is correct structure of isopropyl 2,2-dimethylpropanoate?
en.solution:
Concept : In an ester $\text{R}-\text{COO}-\text{R}'$, the group $\text{R}'$ attached to the oxygen atom is named as an alkyl group.
